name: kata
description: Practised sequences for Claude Code: define your own commands, chain them into modes, run a whole mode or a single step from the terminal with its own slash command, and watch the run live: current step, issues found and fixed, branch and progress.

source.title: Library source
source.description: Where /kata reads commands and modes: a claude.ai artifact (the Kata Library page) or only the local library file, ~/.claude/kata/library.json.

artifactUrl.title: Kata Library artifact URL
artifactUrl.description: The claude.ai artifact that holds your commands and modes. Leave empty to use the local library only.

blockTrailers.title: Block commit trailers
blockTrailers.description: Refuse git commits whose message carries Co-Authored-By, Generated-with or Signed-off-by lines: during a Kata run, always, or never.

showBand.title: Show the run band above the prompt
showBand.description: Draw the current mode, step and last command in a band above the prompt while a run is active.

notify.title: Notify when a run waits or ends
notify.description: Send a native notification when a run pauses for your go-ahead and when it ends, so you can step away while it works.
